name: Punishmentv
source:
Welcome to Punishment.tv! 

What is it:
- This is a 18+ 'Follow Along' Virtual Dom side project I have been working on for months and is finally in a state to be released to the public! 
- A visual novel style dominant game where you play the sub, obeying and letting that virtual dom have his way with you, ideal for those huffy nights where you just want a quick dom fix.

[From [url=https://potheplatypus.itch.io/punishmentv]Itch.io[/url]]
